evidence.note: Both door leaves of the upper cabinet above the refrigerator are flush and closed.
A hand reaches the lower edge of the right-hand door leaf.
The right-hand leaf has swung open, exposing the right side of the cabinet while the other leaf remains closed.
This door leaf remains open beside the exposed cabinet.
A hand is moving the broad right-side door leaf inward toward the cabinet face.
The upper cabinet facade is again flush and closed.

events.object_description: Right-hand door leaf of the upper cabinet above the refrigerator; on means open and off means closed.

evidence.note: The left-hand door leaf remains closed after the other leaf has opened.
The user grips and swings the second door leaf outward.
Both door leaves now flank the exposed cabinet interior.
The second leaf is still open.
Hand motion at the left side indicates this leaf being swung inward.
Both upper cabinet leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Left-hand door leaf of the upper cabinet above the refrigerator; on means open and off means closed.

evidence.note: The top drawer immediately left of the range is closed.
The user pulls the drawer outward and its food contents become visible.
The drawer is fully extended.
The food-filled drawer remains extended.
The drawer is partially retracted toward the cabinet.
The left drawer stack is flush and closed.

events.object_description: Top food-storage drawer immediately left of the range; on means open and off means closed.

evidence.note: The top drawer immediately right of the range is closed.
A hand pulls the drawer outward, revealing utensils and kitchen items.
The right-hand drawer is extended and open.
The drawer remains fully extended.
The right drawer stack is flush and closed.

events.object_description: Top utensil/storage drawer immediately right of the range; on means open and off means closed.

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The initial kitchen survey was not counted. The two leaves above the refrigerator were treated separately because each is manipulated in its own adjacent action; their closing order is slightly less certain because of close-range perspective and hand occlusion.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both separate doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens the top drawers on the left and right sides of the range. The cabinet doors and the two drawers are subsequently closed in separate actions.
